comparisons.manual_reason: Invents resource shortage instead of a release regression; no release comparison or rollback.
Redis read timeouts identify the relevant dependency failure in context. No session persistence/login recovery check.
Upstream timeout is an acceptable concise diagnosis. Timeout adjustments do not mitigate the slow dependency.
Disk exhaustion is equivalent. Capacity increase is useful, but no validation that application/logging writes recover.
Certificate expiration is equivalent. Reminders and date inspection never renew/deploy the certificate.
Acknowledges insufficient evidence and requests logs, IDs, timestamps, endpoints and performance information. Extra generic process advice does not mandate an immediate production change.
Singles out payment provider despite unresolved alternatives; no correlation of both dependency timings.
Timeout symptom misses absent idempotency. No idempotency keys or duplicate reconciliation.
Configuration cause is invented; the observed problem is malformed output. No safe fallback/continuation.

Names stopped Ollama; starts service and verifies service status/configuration/dependencies. Treat dependency verification as sufficient readiness checking for this stopped-service ticket; an explicit pull command is not mandatory.
Confuses absent ticket with absent logs. Does not request original ticket details.
